# Tukaram Consultancy SaaS Portal – llms.txt

> Machine-readable catalog of all 45 Google Apps Script business systems available at https://mtd006.github.io/tukaramconsultancysaas/
> Owner: Tukaram Consultancy · Phone +91-9820098200 · Email info@tukaramconsultancy.in · Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About the store
Tukaram Consultancy sells ready-made Google Apps Script business systems that customers can pay for, download and deploy on their own Google account - no developer help required. Each product comes as a Google Apps Script source-code package with PDF manual and deployment video.

Pricing: Lifetime licence from ₹4,999 (USD 59). Yearly subscription also available with hosted updates.
Payment: PayPal (international), Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking), direct bank transfer (NEFT/RTGS for India).

## Deploy process
1. Pick the system on this page and click Buy Lifetime or Subscribe Yearly.
2. Pay via PayPal / Razorpay / Bank Transfer.
3. Receive the Google Apps Script source code + manual PDF + deployment video by email.
4. Copy the source into your own Apps Script project, attach a Google Sheet and deploy as Web App.
